Visitor replaces line break with custom output

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorLineBreakCustom struct {
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}

func (v *testVisitorVisitorLineBreakCustom) VisitLineBreak(ctx htmd.NodeContext) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultCustom(` | `)
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorLineBreakCustom{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<p>First line<br>Second line<br>Third line</p>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
